scene_target: Artie meets Fizz and begins the character creation process.
goal: Introduce the system guide and initiate character creation.
conflict: Artie's confusion and denial versus Fizz's chipper system administration.
end_condition: Artie accepts his death and opens the stat allocation menu.
transition_in_text: Artie floats in the void, recovering from his electrocution, as a glowing pixelated fairy appears.
transition_out_text: Artie stares at the stat allocation screen, ready to build his character.

last_scene: Artie met Fizz, a pixelated fairy and system guide, in the Character Creation Void.
Fizz confirmed that Artie died from the vending machine electrocution and was flagged as an Anomaly.
Artie accepted his death and Fizz opened the stat allocation menu for him to build his character.
